name: Bågenholm
source:
Member of "The Six". Perpetually inebriated to cope with the terrible knowledge that comes with her gift of precognition.

She is never involved in the military operations of her comrades as her sole function is to relay the prophecies she receives on an irregular basis to the commander. They trust her implicitly as every single prophecy she has delivered has come to pass despite her unconscious obfuscation of details (human frames cannot cope with the information overload and its consequences).

[Spoiler] She is capable of using her prophetic abilities in a proactive manner and has kept a special alcoholic hallucinogen used by her forefathers for this purpose in Sachi's route. She pays for her knowledge with her life but her role is indispensable in creating the conditions necessary for the remaining American agents to fight back. [/Spoiler]
